title: Enforcing Code Reasoning in Agentic Scaffold for More Effective Issue Resolution
title_zh: 在智能体框架中强制代码推理以更有效地解决问题

paragraphs.en: 总结：研究提出DeskCheck框架，通过系统性引导代码推理，显著提升智能体解决代码仓库级问题的成功率。 Reasoning is central to ReAct-based programming agents, yet whether and how they reason about code remains unclear. We study 7,955 issue-resolution trajectories from six single- and multi-agent scaffolds across four programming languages on SWE-bench-Verified, SWE-bench-Pro, and SWE-bench-Lite. We identify 12 forms of code reasoning in 66.95% of trajectories. Code reasoning is associated with higher resolution rates, and its intensity increases with task complexity. However, it remains largely unguided: agents may focus on surface-level symptoms during localization, fail to refine near-correct patches, overlook issue requirements, and generate tests with limited behavioral diversity. To address these limitations, we propose DeskCheck, an agentic scaffold that systematically guides code reasoning throughout repository-level issue resolution. DeskCheck simulates execution paths to localize root causes, simulates candidate patches to refine near-misses, audits patches against issue requirements, and reasons about corner-case inputs and expected outputs before generating tests. On 731 SWE-bench-Pro instances, DeskCheck improves resolution rates over mini-SWE-Agent and Claude Code by 6.29% to 10.53%, at an additional cost of $0.02-$0.28 per instance (average: $0.14). Per-phase analyses show higher method-level localization recall, more successful repairs of imprecisely localized issues, and better detection of missed corner cases in near-correct patches. Exact McNemar tests show statistically significant improvements across all subject LLMs (p < 10^-10), while repeated experiments support robustness to agent nondeterminism. These findings motivate systematic code reasoning as a means of improving programming agents.
paragraphs.zh: 总结：研究提出DeskCheck框架，通过系统性引导代码推理，显著提升智能体解决代码仓库级问题的成功率。推理是基于ReAct的编程智能体的核心，但它们是否以及如何对代码进行推理仍不清楚。 我们研究了来自六种单智能体与多智能体框架、覆盖四种编程语言的7,955条问题解决轨迹，实验基于SWE-bench-Verified、SWE-bench-Pro和SWE-bench-Lite。 我们在66.95%的轨迹中识别出12种代码推理形式。 代码推理与更高的解决率相关，且其强度随任务复杂度增加而提升。 然而，代码推理在很大程度上缺乏引导：智能体可能在定位阶段只关注表层症状，无法改进接近正确的补丁，忽视问题描述的要求，并生成行为多样性有限的测试。 为解决这些局限，我们提出DeskCheck，一个在代码仓库级问题解决全过程中系统性引导代码推理的智能体框架。 DeskCheck通过模拟执行路径来定位根本原因，通过模拟候选补丁来改进接近正确的方案，依据问题描述要求审计补丁，并在生成测试前对边界情况输入与预期输出进行推理。 在731个SWE-bench-Pro实例上，DeskCheck将解决率相比mini-SWE-Agent和Claude Code提升了6.29%至10.53%，每个实例的额外成本为0.02至0.28美元（平均：0.14美元）。 分阶段分析显示，方法级定位召回率更高，对定位不精确问题的修复成功率更高，并能更好地检测接近正确的补丁中遗漏的边界情况。 精确McNemar检验表明，所有被测大语言模型上的改进均具有统计显著性（p < 10^-10），而重复实验则支持其对智能体非确定性的鲁棒性。 这些发现表明，系统性代码推理是改进编程智能体的一种有效途径。
